summary: Marketing is in active execution mode, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO while advancing the knowledge website redesign and preparing for the Tech in Asia event, with urgent attention needed on conversion tracking and event logistics.
summaryDetail: The team is executing on the decision to prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for SEO and marketing, with Joseph tasked to create SEO target drafts and the team analyzing participant data to define target audiences; conversion tracking is being audited to ensure effectiveness. The knowledge website redesign is progressing with a review of Joseph's alternative design, incorporating his ideas to show more articles and bring indices to the homepage, while removing the videos panel and integrating videos into topic sections. For the upcoming Tech in Asia event (Aug 21), logistics are in motion: booth G1 is reserved, F&B and KV feedback are pending from LIU Xuan, and RSVPs and event details are being finalized for the Aug 25 event with Professor Li Wei. Additionally, content tasks are underway: English translations of Li Haitao articles are being sent for Dean's approval, the Indonesia program page is live, and the Worldwide Locations sub-heading is being reworked. This week, urgent priorities include completing the conversion tracking audit, providing feedback on Joseph's design, and confirming Tech in Asia event details to avoid last-minute issues.
